entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a helmet. Order number is 772-91B.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order... 772-91B. Got it. I see the Trail Helmet here.
Yes. Can I return it or not? I don't have all day.
I understand you're busy. To make sure I handle this correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The color just isn't what I expected. The box is still unopened, never even touched it.

No problem, I appreciate you clarifying. Let me just check the purchase date... I see it was delivered 65 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for you.

Of course. I've just emailed the prepaid return label to you. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
